notes: School Immunization Survey Summary by County workbooks per school year (.xls from 2023-24, .xlsx before). The page also links statewide 'Summary for Pa' / 'SurveySummaryState' workbooks and PDFs of everything; the pattern selects the by-county workbooks only. The file list sits inside a JSON attribute on the page, not plain anchors, and the page loads recaptcha/api.js; discover_links() handles both.
